Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Farmhouse Milk Jug Stoneware Home Decor Flower Vase - 6.25 x 5.75 Inches, Cream and Clay
Colors: Cream and Clay
Materials: Stoneware
At first glance it looks like an antique milk jug, but it's actually a stoneware piece sized to hold a small houseplant or freshly cut flowers. The earth-tone clay of the base also shows through the milky white glazing on the upper portion. 5.75" Diameter x 6.25" H Can serve as a vase for fresh cut flowers or as a small planter 100% stoneware Does not have drainage holes
